procedure.project: Use a scratch project.godot with a 1920x1080 base viewport and junctions to the resource directories in this worktree. The movie writer renders the base viewport.
procedure.cut: Zero-based source frames with exclusive ends. Wave starts use the visible HUD digit. Each pick holds for 120 rendered frames. End the second cut on highlighted Gloria, before the single post-choice frame.
procedure.video: FFmpeg trim by source frame, reset timestamps, libx264 CRF 18, yuv420p, original 60 fps. Full-range camera pixels are converted to limited-range YUV. AAC stereo audio is trimmed to the same interval. Playback speed is 1x.
procedure.pairs: Decode the same absolute 60 Hz source frame in each before/after clip. Each half is 960x540. The eight-template seed-7 route changes the encounters. The old and new simulation timers can differ.
